cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, struct

data = open('trunc.db', 'rb').read()
assert data[0] == 0x0d, data[0]
ncell = struct.unpack('>H', data[3:5])[0]
ptrs = [struct.unpack('>H', data[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(ncell)]

def varint(buf, off):
    val = 0
    for i in range(9):
        b = buf[off+i]
        if i == 8:
            val = (val << 8) | b
            return val, off+9
        val = (val << 7) | (b & 0x7f)
        if not (b & 0x80):
            return val, off+i+1

def parse_cell(off):
    plen, p = varint(data, off)
    rowid, p = varint(data, p)
    payload = data[p:p+plen]
    hlen, hp = varint(payload, 0)
    serials = []
    while hp < hlen:
        st, hp = varint(payload, hp)
        serials.append(st)
    # data area starts at hlen
    dp = hlen
    vals = []
    for st in serials:
        if st == 0:
            vals.append(None)
        elif 1 <= st <= 6:
            n = [0,1,2,3,4,6,8][st]
            v = int.from_bytes(payload[dp:dp+n], 'big', signed=True)
            dp += n
            vals.append(v)
        elif st == 7:
            v = struct.unpack('>d', payload[dp:dp+8])[0]
            dp += 8
            vals.append(v)
        elif st == 8:
            vals.append(0)
        elif st == 9:
            vals.append(1)
        elif st >= 12:
            n = (st - 12) // 2 if st % 2 == 0 else (st - 13) // 2
            raw = payload[dp:dp+n]
            dp += n
            vals.append(raw if st % 2 == 0 else raw.decode('utf-8'))
    return rowid, vals

rows = []
for ptr in sorted(ptrs):
    rowid, vals = parse_cell(ptr)
    # schema: (id NULL/rowid-alias, word TEXT, value INTEGER/REAL)
    word, value = vals[1], vals[2]
    rows.append({'rowid': rowid, 'word': word, 'value': value})
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['rowid'])
print(rows)
out = [{'word': r['word'], 'value': r['value']} for r in rows]
with open('recover.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(open('recover.json').read())
PY
ls -l recover.json
